mapper.select: SELECT trip_id FROM trip.trip_members WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ACTIVE'

WITH visible_reactions AS ( SELECT r.*, p.display_name, p.profile_image_url FROM preference.user_place_reactions r JOIN auth.user_profiles p ON p.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.reaction IN ('LIKE', 'SUPER_LIKE') AND r.user_id IN CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND (r.user_id = CAST(#{viewerId} AS uuid) OR p.profile_visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR (p.profile_visibility = 'PRIVATE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM social.user_follows f WHERE f.follower_user_id = CAST(#{viewerId} AS uuid) AND f.following_user_id = r.user_id AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL))) ), candidates AS ( SELECT a.* FROM tourism_source.attractions a WHERE a.longitude BETWEEN #{west} AND #{east} AND a.latitude BETWEEN #{south} AND #{north} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_reactions r WHERE r.provider = 'KTO' AND r.external_place_id = CAST(a.content_id AS text)) ORDER BY a.content_id LIMIT 200 ) SELECT r.provider, r.external_place_id, a.title AS name, CONCAT_WS(' ', a.addr1, a.addr2) AS address, a.latitude AS lat, a.longitude AS lng, img.public_url AS thumbnail_url, ct.content_type_name AS category, CAST(r.user_id AS text) AS user_id, r.display_name, r.profile_image_url, r.reaction FROM candidates a JOIN visible_reactions r ON r.provider = 'KTO' AND r.external_place_id = CAST(a.content_id AS text) LEFT JOIN tourism_source.contenttypes ct ON ct.content_type_id = a.content_type_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public_url FROM tourism_source.attraction_images WHERE attraction_no = a.no AND is_active = true ORDER BY display_order, created_at LIMIT 1) img ON true ORDER BY a.content_id, r.user_id
